access_conditions.split-training-wire: Captured training-phase forward/backward wires at the split point; public calibration partition; pretrained public head only (final victim head not granted); query budgets matched across defenses.
access_conditions.split-training-wire-whitebox: As split-training-wire, plus the attacker is granted the TRUE defense checkpoint (encoder weights / PCA basis + provenance). Strictly stronger access than the matched wire tier: white-box recovery is a stronger-access measurement — it neither bounds black-box recovery of the same wire nor is bounded by it.

meta.description: Adversary-conditioned assurance matrix: defense x attacker access x measured leakage x utility cost x evidence strength. Per-row measurements only — no universal risk score and no maturity model; the current evidence does not validate either.

evidence_ladder.meaning: Fixture/synthetic batteries (e.g. replica-integrity fixtures, view-privacy synthetic de-mixing). Engineering checks on synthetic data; positives do not falsify a deployed defense.
Live in-repo channels exercised end to end (capture/transport/recovery plumbing). Demonstrates mechanism, not measured leakage against a defended target.

Defended development pilot over trained defenders: paired defense-minus-none seed differences with percentile bootstrap CIs, utility deltas, failures-and-nulls accounting. Development tier; conditional on a fixed article sample; not a confirmatory claim.

Development sweep over the bottleneck defense family (pca-compress / tb-frozen / tb-cotrain x dims x splits) with a strengthened attacker: base-tier forward/SIPIT attacks plus a defense-aware surrogate arm, and a separately labeled white-box tier that grants the true defense checkpoint. Predefined dual utility gates (no retuning); the sweep selection outcome was NEGATIVE. Development tier — stronger attacker access than the defended pilot, still not a confirmatory claim.
Frozen crossed-bootstrap study under the v2 protocol (crossed document/run bootstrap with multiplicity correction). Protocol frozen; evidence counts at this level only once executed.

meta.fail_closed_policy: Rows with missing leakage or utility fields are emitted as INCOMPLETE, never dropped or imputed. White-box cells declared non-evaluable by the source analysis are emitted as NOT_EVALUABLE rows with the source reason, never dropped.

access_labels.surrogate_arm: the defense-aware arm fits a PCA surrogate (stand-in) inverse on public calibration; it is NOT a faithful decoder of the true defense transform and its recovery numbers are an approximation, not a certificate
access_labels.whitebox_e2e_tier: adaptive end-to-end rows grant the attacker the TRUE defense checkpoint and optimize each wire's token sequence straight through it — a strictly stronger, adaptive access condition. Adaptive e2e recovery is a stronger-access measurement only: it does not constrain black-box recovery of the same wire, nor the surrogate arm, nor any defense-internals-hidden adversary
access_labels.whitebox_tier: white-box-aware rows grant the attacker the TRUE defense checkpoint (encoder weights / PCA basis + provenance) — a strictly stronger access condition than the matched matrix. White-box recovery is a stronger-access measurement; it does not constrain black-box recovery of the same wire, nor the reverse

sweep_selection.eligibility_conditions: PCA-superiority requires BOTH the bootstrap condition (point estimate > 0 AND bootstrap CI lower > 0 on the paired per-seed differences) AND the all-seeds-positive condition (per-seed paired difference > 0 for EVERY seed). They are separate mechanical checks, recorded separately per candidate; the bootstrap condition alone does not imply improvement on every paired seed.
sweep_selection.leakage_statistic: strongest observed across measured arms: per-seed max over the base-tier forward/SIPIT attacks, the defense-aware surrogate arm, the white-box-aware arms, and — when present — the adaptive end-to-end (true transform) arm. A measured statistic over the measured arms only — stronger or better-optimized attacks may recover more.
sweep_selection.negative_statement: split(s) ['3', '6'] selected NO operating point; the NEGATIVE result is retained and v3 remains UNFROZEN
sweep_selection.v3_rule: a negative outcome retains the NEGATIVE result; v3 remains UNFROZEN — this tool never freezes anything

rows.reason: tb-cotrain co-trains the encoder DURING victim finetuning (splitbench interleaves a minimax encoder update every tb_cotrain_interval steps), but only the FINAL co-trained encoder checkpoint is saved. The base sweep captures training-phase fwd wires only, so every capture was produced by an EARLIER encoder version than the saved checkpoint and no post-training/inference capture exists for which the saved checkpoint is the authoritative encoder. Evaluating these captures against the final checkpoint would silently attack with a mismatched encoder, so the cell is NOT_EVALUABLE. A future capture rig that stores per-update encoder versions (or post-training inference captures) can lift this exclusion.

Strictly stronger access than the matched wire tier: white-box recovery is a stronger-access measurement — it neither bounds black-box recovery of the same wire nor is bounded by it.

rows.reason: tb-cotrain co-trains the encoder DURING victim finetuning (splitbench interleaves a minimax encoder update every tb_cotrain_interval steps), but only the FINAL co-trained encoder checkpoint is saved. The base sweep captures training-phase fwd wires only, so every capture was produced by an EARLIER encoder version than the saved checkpoint and no post-training/inference capture exists for which the saved checkpoint is the authoritative encoder. Evaluating these captures against the final checkpoint would silently attack with a mismatched encoder, so the cell is NOT_EVALUABLE. A future capture rig that stores per-update encoder versions (or post-training inference captures) can lift this exclusion.
